[1/5] Plan: Grid Pulse world simulation layer - clock/shifts, grid alert, generated news, ambient events, host re-securing, drifting market prices, CLI/Web surfaces, tests, ADR-015

impact_assessment.why: The grid is static between runs: turns advance only to tick daemons, hosts never react to loud intrusions, black-market prices never move, and nothing in or out of game reports on the player's actions, so the advertised simulation depth is thin.
impact_assessment.benefits: A living-grid feedback loop: every turn advances an in-game clock and generates events; loud play raises grid alert, which drives headlines, patrol trace, host re-securing, and market prices, with consequences legible in both CLI and Web.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState and Node gain additive defaulted fields and shop gains an optional price modifier; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: server serializes sessions with its existing lock; state: old saves must load with default world state and nodes without breach ledgers
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive dataclass defaults plus from_dict backfill, a dedicated deterministic world RNG independent from engine.rng, failing-first golden-path and old-save tests, aikit check after each milestone, and ADR-015 documenting the schema change.

[1/5] Plan: NetWatch Counter-Infiltration & Active Hunters - NetWatchHunter model, autonomous grid tracking, interception mechanics, countermeasures (stealth/logic bomb), CLI/Web surfaces, tests, ADR-016

impact_assessment.why: At high grid alert (60%+), corporate response is currently passive and non-spatial; players lack a direct predatory threat to outmaneuver across subnets, reducing late-game tension.
impact_assessment.benefits: Active NetWatch hunters add thrilling cat-and-mouse spatial tactics: players must track hunter proximity, make evasive lateral moves, wipe logs to throw off scent, or deploy exploit chips to counter-attack.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: WorldState gains hunters list with default; dependency: none (pure stdlib); concurrency: mutations serialized by existing session lock; state: existing saves load cleanly with empty hunters list
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive defaults on WorldState and NetWatchHunter dataclasses, from_dict backward compatibility tests, isolated world_rng stream, failing-first unit/integration tests for hunter pathfinding and interception.

[1/3] Plan: Add zero-friction start launcher files (start.py, start.bat, start.sh), CLI forwarding, tests, README update

impact_assessment.why: Users need a single one-click or single-command entry point to launch CyberPulse without remembering module syntax or flags.
impact_assessment.benefits: Delivers zero-friction instant onboarding: double-clicking start.bat or running python start.py launches CyberPulse immediately.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Standalone stdlib-only launcher, argument forwarding tests in test_cli.py, hygiene and secret scans via aikit check cyberpulse.
